description: The relay holds applied generation 42 on an established connection. The app peer's desired-state generation advances to 43 and it sends the server-initiated state.changed nudge carrying only the new generation. The relay responds with its own state.pull — desired state itself still moves exclusively as a pull response (the app peer never sends an unsolicited snapshot, REL-050) — verifies and applies the answered snapshot at generation 43, and acknowledges with state.ack. The nudge is best-effort and coalescible; it carries no payload beyond generation.
